entities.summary: Boris Yakovlevich Vladimirtsov was a Russian and Soviet orientalist, Mongolist, and linguist. He became a member of the Academy of Sciences of the USSR in 1929. Vladimirtsov was a specialist in Mongolian linguistics and literature, as well as the history and ethnography of the Mongolian peoples.
